nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template listing all environment variables required to run icarKno, covering Elasticsearch, AI provider keys (Gemini, Mistral OCR, OpenAI), MongoDB/MySQL/Neo4j credentials, Bhashini and ElevenLabs speech keys, and GPU inference server settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines 24 environment variables spanning vector search, multiple LLM/translation providers, three database backends, and a self-hosted GPU inference server, reflecting the platform's multi-provider AI architecture.

nodes.name: api-documentation.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive REST API reference for icarKno covering authentication, rate limits, document upload/session management, query and streaming endpoints, knowledge graph generation, payment/account management, multi-language translation, health checks, WhatsApp webhook integration, error handling, and example workflows with a Python SDK sample.
nodes.languageNotes: Organized into 74 sections/subsections by feature area (documents, query, knowledge graphs, account, multi-language, utility, WhatsApp), each typically documenting request parameters and JSON response shapes.

nodes.name: readme.md
nodes.summary: Top-level project README for icarKno, a document intelligence platform; describes features (document processing, hybrid search, AI capabilities, multi-language support), quick start/installation, usage examples, architecture diagram, project structure, configuration, deployment via Docker, and contribution guidelines.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes an ASCII architecture diagram showing Client Apps -> Flask API -> AI Services with a shared Data Layer (Elasticsearch, MongoDB, MySQL, Neo4j), and a project structure tree referencing app/, controllers/, elastic/, utils/, webhook/, and run.py.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python dependency manifest pinning versions for the Flask/FastAPI web layer, document processing libraries, LangChain/Elasticsearch vector search stack, Hugging Face transformers and summarization models, multi-database clients (MongoDB, MySQL/SQLAlchemy), authentication, and web scraping utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: Groups dependencies by concern (Web Framework, Document Processing, Vector Store and Embedding, AI Services, Database, Authentication, Utilities) and flags a known compatibility risk between bert-extractive-summarizer and torch/transformers versions via an inline comment.

nodes.name: results.csv
nodes.summary: Benchmark/test results dataset capturing query latency and quality metrics for the document Q&A pipeline, recording per-user-ID question, HTTP status code, total response time, time-to-first-byte, answer length, estimated tokens/sec, an answer preview, error text, and a success flag.
nodes.languageNotes: Tabular load-test/evaluation output (170 rows) used to assess query response latency (TTFB up to ~120s observed) and answer quality of the RAG query endpoint described in api-documentation.md.
